title: fix(ui): a child amount that follows its parent's currency draws in the parent's currency
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x4rSY8MkzQaGw1phkoLxkEv)_

Fixes #31912

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Known follow-up, not fixed here: #32334 (the grid footer's whole-set query still sends a raw `sum` over a following amount, which the engine refuses; this PR suppresses nothing).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：主从子对象上的金额若把币种字段写成 `invoice.currency_code`（沿用父记录币种），控制台现在在表格、列表视图、记录表单与详情、父记录页的相关列表（含合计行）、主从表单与明细行面板里都按父记录币种显示符号和小数位；父对象上声明了币种的汇总字段按父币种显示为金额；Studio 币种选择器能选出 `关系.字段`，已存的路径不再显示「未找到」；`currencyField` 帮助文本说明了父路径和父币种锁定。
- 为什么改：ADR-0144 D2/D6 修订（#31743）允许子对象沿用父币种，引擎侧已落地，控制台此前把这类金额显示成无符号、日元两位小数或租户币种。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `ui/` 显示与读取投影、一行 spec 帮助文本和翻译包；同级 `currency_code` 指针行为不变（在隐藏代码列的表格里现在也能显示正确符号）；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`@object-ui/i18n` 的 `resolveFieldCurrency`（唯一解析器）与 `withFollowedParent`；`objectGridRowLoad` / `ListView` 的投影改动。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridParentCurrency-31912.test.tsx`，预期 3 例全过（EUR 行 `€1,234.50`、JPY 行 `¥1,234`）。
- 需要你做的：席位评审待做。

## Repro, before and after

Fixture: child `inv_line` with `invoice` (`master_detail` → `inv`) and `amount` (`record`, `currencyField: 'invoice.currency_code'`); control `amount2` (`record`, sibling `currency_code`). Parents `i1` EUR and `i2` JPY; tenant USD, locale en-US. Readings taken with the real renderers and a data source that honours `$select` and `$expand`.

| Surface | Before (main) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Object grid / list view, invoice column not shown | `$select` without `invoice`, no `$expand`; `1,234.50` and `1,234.00` | `invoice` expanded; `€1,234.50` and `¥1,234` |
| Same, invoice column shown | `1,234.50` / `1,234.00` (the resolver read `row['invoice.currency_code']`) | `€1,234.50` / `¥1,234` |
| Sibling `amount2`, code column not shown | `currency_code` not selected; `10.00` / `10.00` | `currency_code` selected; `€10.00` / `¥10` |
| Record form field (`invoice` as a bare id) | no adornment, step 0.01; read-only `1,234.50` | one read of the parent's code field; `€1,234.50` |
| Detail view of a line | `1,234.50` | `invoice` expanded even when no section shows it; `€1,234.50` |
| Related list on the parent's page | `1,234.50`, `100.00`, no totals line | `€1,234.50`, `€100.00`, totals `€1,334.50`; a sibling amount now reads its row's code |
| Master-detail form and line-items panel | `$1,234.50` (tenant) | `€1,234.50`, totals stack in EUR |
| Parent roll-up `summary` declaring its currency | `1,334.5` in both faces | `€1,334.50` in the cell and on the form |
| Studio picker with a stored `invoice.currency_code` | "invoice.currency_code (not found)", no parent path offered | reads as the pick; `invoice.currency_code` offered |

## What changes

### One resolver (`@object-ui/i18n`)

- `resolveFieldCurrency` reads a two-segment `currencyField` as `<master_detail>.<parent code field>`: the code is the parent row's code field, read off the row expanded under that relation. A bare id there holds no code and reads as none, never the tenant's.
- New exports: `recordCurrencyPath` (the split pointer), `recordCurrencyReadField` (what a projection must read: the `master_detail` with an expand, or the sibling code field), `withFollowedParent` (lays a host's parent row under the relation, unless the row already holds an object or names another parent id).

### Projection

- `ObjectGrid` (`objectGridRowLoad`) and `ListView` ask for what a shown record-mode amount reads: the `master_detail` in `$select` and `$expand` for a path, the sibling code field for a sibling pointer, both through the existing gates (declared, readable).
- `DetailView` expands the `master_detail` a shown following amount reads, shown or not.

### Surfaces

- Record form field: `useFollowedParentRecord` reads the parent's code field once per parent id when the form holds the relation as a bare id (`withFollowedParentObject` stamps the parent object on the field in `ObjectForm` and section forms). The home-amount hint and preview read the same record.
- Related list: each record-mode cell receives its row (it received none before), with the page record laid under the relation for a path; the body table's totals line agrees on the same rows.
- Inline grid: `GridField` takes `columnCurrencies`; `MasterDetailForm` and `LineItemsPanel` name the columns whose amount follows the header through their own relationship (`parentCurrencyColumns`), and the master-detail totals stack uses the header's code.
- Summary faces: a `summary` declaring `currencyMode` `record` or `fixed` draws through the currency face (`FormulaCellRenderer` and `SummaryField`) with the parent record.
- Studio: `ObjectCurrencyConfigField` offers `<master_detail>.<code>` for each code field of each parent reached through the object's `master_detail` fields (draft-overlaid reads); a stored path reads as the pick while its parent is unread, and as not found once the parent is read without that field, or through a `lookup`. The record-mode hint in the studio namespace says so (en, zh).

### Help text

- `currencyConfig.currencyField` in `field.form.ts` names the parent path and the parent-code lock (ADR-0144 D2 as amended). `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` regenerated the en metadata-forms pack; the ten translated packs carry the same sentence (values only, key sets unchanged); no source-hash row changed.

## Tests

- Resolver: `resolveFieldCurrency.recordMode-27188.test.ts`, a new describe (path read, bare id, blank code, two lines one parent, two parents, sibling preserved, `withFollowedParent`).
- One pin file per surface: `gridParentCurrency-31912`, `ListView.parentCurrency-31912`, `parentCurrency.faces-31912` (form field, summary faces, inline grid), `lineItemsParentCurrency-31912`, `masterDetailParentCurrency-31912`, `RelatedList.parentCurrency-31912`, `DetailView.parentCurrency-31912`, `CurrencyConfigField.parentPath-31912`. Each carries the sibling-pointer control where the surface reads one.
- 16 ablations, each turning its pins red, each restored to `git diff HEAD` empty: resolver path arm, grid expand, grid sibling select, list expand, list sibling select, form parent read, summary form face, summary cell face, inline grid columns, line-items panel hand-off, master-detail grid hand-off, master-detail totals, related-list cells, related-list totals, detail-view expand, Studio parent candidates.

## Acceptance notes

- Footer whole-set aggregate over a following amount: #32334, reported, not suppressed. A group header keyed by the dotted path itself (`invoice.currency_code`) would also keep a `sum`; it is not reachable from the group picker as far as read, and is reported, not changed.
- `deriveMasterDetail` is untouched: the work needed nothing from it, and this branch merges main after #32283 landed. A master-detail collection whose every column is authored with a type reads no child schema, so its lines keep the tenant currency; collections that read the schema (the derived and hydrated ones) follow the header.
- The inline grid's sibling record-mode columns still draw the tenant currency, as on main; only parent-following columns are named.
- The inline grid footer total stays a plain number, as on main.
- The home-amount hint beside a following amount reads the parent's code once the form record holds the expanded parent or the parent read has landed.
- `summaryDeclaresCurrency` also draws a `fixed` summary as money in its fixed currency; the spec admits `fixed` on a non-count summary.

## Verification

- Gates: every command `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` lists, plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` and `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`, recorded as `<cmd> :: exit N` on the head this PR opens at (`491ec104`): 91 of 91 exit 0, after a full `turbo run build` and a console `vite build` as prerequisites.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/i18n`, `fields`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form` and `app-shell`: exit 0.
- The full suites of `ui/packages/{i18n,fields,plugin-grid,plugin-list,plugin-detail,plugin-form}` and the Studio inspectors: 1,691 files and 19,571 tests passed, 0 failed.
- Eager closure, two console `vite build`s (this branch, and the same tree with the touched `ui/` sources restored from main): eager gzip 2,269,685 → 2,271,122 B (+1,437). The parts that moved: `i18n-runtime` +224 (the resolver), `ui-components` +535 (`@object-ui/fields`: the form read, the grid hand-off, the summary faces), `plugin-grid` +280, `plugin-form` +217, `plugins-views` +139, `i18n-ns-studio-en` +25 (the record-mode hint); the rest is ±13 B of chunk-hash churn. `check:eager-closure` passes. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` is unchanged (294,224 B).
